title: Something Salty | Exclusive 30A Vacation Rental
meta_description: Book your stay at Something Salty on 30A – a charming beach home with stunning views and amenities.
description_expanded: Something Salty Private Coastal Retreat Near Seagrove Beach Home Introduction Unwind in style at Something Salty , a beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath retreat in Seagrove Beach. With a private pool, expansive outdoor living, and access to an LSV (golf cart) and bikes , this home offers the perfect blend of relaxation, comfort, and coastal adventure just moments from the beach . Home Highlights Private Pool - Heated October through April for an additional fee, with sun shelf and lounge chairs 6-Seater LSV (Golf Cart) - Included with stay, serviced by La Dolce Vita, waiver required 4 Taxi Bikes - Serviced and maintained by La Dolce Vita Outdoor Living - Summer kitchen with built-in gas grill, covered patio, and screened-in lounge with TV Sleeping for 15 Guests - 4 private suites plus additional sleeping space Gourmet Kitchen - Thermador oven, built-in refrigerator, double dishwashers, butler's pantry, and coffee station Additional Bar Area - Beverage fridge for easy entertaining Dining Space - Seating for 8 plus breakfast bar for 4 4 Luxury Suites - Spa-style bathrooms and Smart TVs throughout Second Floor Lounge - Reading nook, Smart TV, and queen sleeper sofa Laundry Room - First floor with high-efficiency washer and dryer Outdoor Shower - Convenient after beach days Beach Proximity - 350 yards to Walton Dunes Beach Access with no stairs Parking for 4 Vehicles - Driveway only, no garage access, no street or trailer parking Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens professionally laundered after every stay Location Perks 1-minute bike ride to Eastern Lake Boat Launch for kayaking, paddleboarding, and fishing 1-minute bike ride to Buddy's Seafood Market, Old Florida Fish House, Beachy Bean Coffee Company, Kahve and Cream, and Seagrove Liquor and Wine 5-minute bike ride to Greenway Station for shopping and dining 9-minute bike ride to The Big Chill for dining, entertainment, and family activities Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for bookings of 10 days or longer and is included in your reservation Pool heating is available October through April for an additional fee LSV use requires a signed waiver prior to use Concierge services available for beach bonfires, grocery delivery, bike rentals, and more Pristine elegance awaits at Something Salty, where days are spent poolside, evenings are filled with coastal breezes, and every detail is designed for a memorable 30A escape. Located at the end of a quiet street just steps from the beach, this home offers a peaceful setting while keeping you close to the best dining, shopping, and outdoor experiences in Seagrove Beach.
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | Smart TV, view of pool deck, ensuite spa bath with dual vanity sinks and oversized walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | Smart TV, private balcony overlooking pool area, ensuite bath with dual vanity sink and wet room with soaking tub and walk-in shower
2nd Floor Queen Suite (Sleeps 3) | twin daybed, Smart TV, ensuite bath with vanity sink and oversized walk-in shower
2nd Floor Bunk Suite (Sleeps 6) | two Twin over Queen Bunks, Smart TV, ensuite bath with combination
Bonus | Queen Sleeper Sofa in the 2nd Floor Lounge

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
